merc_honesty.why: Go module metadata carries no license field, so those components have no licenses entry rather than a guessed one. Absence here means undeclared, not permissive.
merc_honesty.model_weights_excluded: Catalogue model weights are third-party artifacts with their own obligations in docs/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, where two rows are BLOCKED. They are excluded so a complete SBOM cannot be read as a license clearance it does not grant.
merc_honesty.graph_scope: go list -m all is the build graph, not the linked subset.
